sections.introduction:
Firstly, what is a dental black triangle? It is a space between two teeth. This space is also called an open gingival embrasure and is not completely filled with gum tissue. This thus results in the triangular gap between teeth and gums. People who have this are willing to repair these black triangles as soon as possible as these triangles not only concern cosmetically but also are having some major health concerns. If looked into the count just roughly then 67% of earth’s population has this dental black triangle. Most of the time it is not related to any type of disease but in some cases the triangle appearance may be suggestive of some dental disease. 
 Moving further, let’s talk about dental black triangles in detail. 


 Highlight Points 

 It is a triangular space between teeth where gum tissue is absent or not able to grow 
 Dental black triangle is common with 67% of prevalence 
 It is having equal occurrence in both genders 
 Problem can start at a young age, say in even 20’s 
 It might have correlation with some buccal cavity disorder or diabetes

 Yes, it can be fixed easily
